customerOutcome: Submit a private product report with clear disclosure and a durable server-confirmed receipt.
entryConditions: Current settled board identity and selected company; the feedback form is keyed by company and principal and does not retain foreign drafts.
Effective customer_feedback_v9 enables new submissions; original domain membership, company availability and request abuse admission remain necessary.
exitConditions: A validated canonical server receipt confirms acceptance. An unconfirmed request keeps its original key, payload and context.
Closing preserves the current in-memory form while mounted. A confirmed new report resets it; company/account withdrawal unmounts it.

content.h1: Share feedback (named native dialog; the enclosing page retains its heading)
content.supportingCopy: Tell us what went wrong or what would make August Works better. This is not monitored for urgent support.
displayedState: Category-specific question and optional goal, included-context disclosure, explicit diagnostics/name choices, unavailable image status and fixed support/security/privacy links.
Pending/unconfirmed submission disables input edits; only an accepted canonical receipt displays the feedback reference.

inputs.label: Feedback category
inputs.dataType: Single select BUG / IMPROVEMENT / IDEA / OTHER
inputs.help: Question labels follow the selected category.

inputs.label: Category-specific feedback question
inputs.help: Customer text is untrusted and never executes tools.

inputs.label: Category-specific optional goal
inputs.help: Describe the desired outcome without mandatory reproduction steps.

inputs.label: This stops me from completing my work
inputs.validation: True is valid only for BUG

inputs.label: Include technical diagnostics
inputs.help: Explicit safe-code/correlation allowlist; no raw logs or screenshots. The current dialog discloses that it has collected no diagnostics and opt-in sends an empty bundle before submission.
inputs.validation: Diagnostics require explicit opt-in; unknown-result retries preserve the originally disclosed immutable bundle.

inputs.label: Do not include my name/contact details
inputs.help: Company/technical context, separate audit and private account ownership remain; this is not anonymity.

primary.label: Send feedback
primary.operation: Submit the exact frozen request; retry only with its original key and payload

secondary: Cancel or close preserves the mounted draft and restores the invoking control.
Retry an unconfirmed submission with its exact original key and payload; a canonical validation refusal allows correction with a new key.
View accepted feedback through My feedback; use separate confirmed support/security/privacy mailto links without prefilled report data.

canonicalReadDomains: Startup-owned strict references for all six Privacy policy purposes; declared references remain execution-unqualified and cannot enable GA.
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: POST canonical Customer Feedback with immutable body/goal and explicit disclosure choices, company membership, durable request key and abuse limit.
systemWork.authorityEffect: Only the canonical feedback owner can accept a submission. No tool/provider/agent effect or permission expansion is caused by feedback content.
systemWork.asyncWork: Explicit submission only, with original native idempotency, current membership and transactional rollout admission. Original limit is twenty requests per principal/company in ten minutes. No automatic retry or report send occurs.
systemWork.receipt: Server-accepted AWF reference. The form never claims acceptance for a lost acknowledgement; private My feedback is separately owned by the same current account.

states.loading: The global trigger waits for settled identity and admission; a pending submission disables form edits and announces sending.
states.empty: A new mounted form has BUG selected and empty body/goal; diagnostics and omit-name are off.
states.partial: Images are explicitly unavailable; optional diagnostics are disclosed as empty. The remaining form can submit through current native admission.
states.stale: Account/company withdrawal removes the keyed form and retained private draft. An unconfirmed submitted snapshot is not recomputed when the dialog reopens.
states.validation_error: Keep entered text; HTML/native bounded category/body/goal validation and canonical rejection allow correction with a new request key.
states.system_error: Fixed translated acknowledgement-unconfirmed copy retains and locks the original payload. Raw exceptions never enter the dialog.
states.permission_denied: Current native membership/company or rollout refusal cannot create a successful receipt or broaden access.
states.recovering: Retry only the retained original submission. Context, disclosure choices and request key stay immutable until a canonical response.
states.success: Show the canonical accepted AWF reference and link to My feedback; do not equate product feedback with urgent support or security incident handling.

navigation.back: The enclosing page remains the navigation context. Closing/reopening within the mounted account/company preserves entered feedback.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Cancel/close returns focus to the connected invoking control. Drafts and diagnostics are never written to persistent browser storage.
navigation.deepLink: Global feedback trigger; accepted history uses the existing private My feedback route.
navigation.resume: An unconfirmed mounted submission retries its original immutable key/payload. Durable cross-reload draft/reconciliation UX still requires separate implementation and acceptance.

accessibility.initialFocus: Native named dialog opens on the labeled category control; the dialog container is not an ordinary focus target.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Fixed submission error announcement receives focus; field validation preserves other text.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Accepted receipt receives focus; Close returns to the invoking control.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Named dialog with category-specific labels, associated disclosure/diagnostic help, fixed error/status and native modal focus containment. The parent retains its main landmark.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Feedback original text and visible messages only in private customer history
dataCollected: Customer-entered feedback and optional goal; current company/private account ownership under the canonical feedback domain.

Safe page category and recognized static screen ID; locale, timezone and viewport category; reported browser/OS family and major version only; client/server build references and server-owned relevant effective feature IDs.

Optional diagnostics remain an explicit empty safe-code/correlation bundle in this dialog. No raw user-agent string, query/fragment, page text, prompts, outputs, logs, form values, automatic screenshots or fingerprint/client-hint requests.
sensitiveFields: Feedback body/goal, optional name, protected private account link and reported metadata remain customer data. No-name is not an anonymity claim.
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Exclude customer prose, prompts, result bodies, attachments and raw errors from generic analytics/activity details; native domain audit is purpose-separated. Startup parser errors omit private configuration; the public no-store policy DTO excludes owner identity and policy refs.

functional: Verify submit/replay/concurrent requests, lost-ACK immutable context, canonical refusal/correction, scope withdrawal, new-work rollout, retained private history and separate support/security/privacy destinations on the exact artifact.
Protected image/scanner, qualified diagnostics, durable reload draft/reconciliation, retention/DSR/legal hold and complete closure remain pending.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current membership/resource revocation, tenant isolation, untrusted content and separate private feedback identity purpose.

Refuse GA for missing required Privacy policy references and for complete declarations without qualified native policy execution; partial/numeric/unknown declarations cannot silently choose legal periods.
Reject unknown/raw environment fields, mismatched screen category and forged server feature IDs. Preserve old request hashes and the original accepted metadata across retries and rollout changes.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
